Hlíðar­ból Farm Guesthouse, set in the peaceful countryside of Fljótshlíð in South Iceland, offers a quiet retreat surrounded by open fields and mountain. Perfect for for families or groups of friends. It has 5 bedrooms. 2x double rooms, 2 twin rooms and 1 single room. There is a well equipped kitchen and nice and bright living room.

The space
Hlíðar­ból Farm Guesthouse in peaceful Fljótshlíð, South Iceland, offers a cozy rural escape with five inviting rooms—four doubles and one single. It features two well-appointed bathrooms with showers, a fully equipped kitchen, and a warm living room with a TV. Surrounded by open fields and mountain views, it’s ideal for families or groups of friends seeking comfort, nature, and quiet countryside charm

The home. the host, the communication and amenities were all good. The AirBnB directions were misleading and it took us to an incorrect location. We finally put in directions provided by the host and got to the right place. The home is pricey for 1 night as compared to some of the other stays which are villa and modern but this was a convenient and available option with 2 bathrooms for when we needed. Plenty of beds to accomodate for 8/9 people, all kitchen amenities avilable. Overall the stay was very decent but not exceptional.
